assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Haidian student population figures (tens of thousands of primary/secondary students) are order-of-magnitude estimates based on public reporting; exact official statistics to be confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Any exact student-count claim in the proposal is an estimate, not an official statistic.

assumptions.statement: Design parameters (e.g., AI council pavilion spacing, spine greenbelt width, branch road density, public compute node spacing) are conceptual design targets of this proposal, not statutory standards.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers should treat these as proposal parameters subject to professional refinement.
